lines.zh: 沉重的脚步声回响在山谷间
lines.en: Heavy footsteps echo in the valley

lines.zh: 装甲摩擦声伴随着我的每一步
我缓缓移动，草叶被踩得沙沙作响
lines.en: Leaves rustle under my steady tread

lines.zh: 我的甲板发出沉闷的碰撞声
lines.en: My plates collide with a dull thud

lines.zh: 剑龙踏过草地，激起一片尘土
lines.en: Stegosaurus stirs up dust as it walks

lines.zh: 我的每一步都显得格外小心谨慎
阳光下，我的鳞片闪耀着金属光泽
lines.en: My plates glint in the sunlight

lines.zh: 厚重的步履踏过柔软的大地
我小心翼翼地在草地上行走
lines.en: I walk cautiously on the grass

lines.zh: 厚重的皮甲摩擦发出轻微声响
lines.en: Armor rubs softly with each step

lines.zh: 我的骨板随步伐轻轻起伏
lines.en: The plates on my back rise and fall as I walk

lines.zh: 四足碾过碎石，稳稳向前
lines.en: Four feet roll over gravel and press on
I turn aside to let a young tree pass

lines.zh: 身后留下两行深深脚印
lines.en: Two deep lines of footprints trail behind me

lines.zh: 我静静地站立，警惕四周
lines.en: I stand still, watching the surroundings

lines.zh: 我仰望天空，等待着日落
lines.en: I look up at the sky, waiting for sunset

lines.zh: 我低头吃着地上的嫩叶
lines.en: I munch on tender leaves on the ground

lines.zh: 我伸展着长长的尾巴，享受阳光
lines.en: I stretch my tail to bask in the sun

lines.zh: 我的眼中闪烁着智慧的光芒
我静静地观察着这片土地
微风吹过，带来花草的香气
lines.en: A gentle breeze brings the scent of flowers

lines.zh: 我静静地站立，享受着宁静
lines.en: I stand quietly, enjoying the peace

lines.zh: 我闭上眼睛，享受片刻宁静
lines.en: I close my eyes, enjoying a moment of calm

lines.zh: 我静静地站立，等待着夜晚来临
lines.en: I stand quietly, waiting for night to fall
My mouth hangs half open as I chew

lines.zh: 尾端的骨刺随呼吸轻摆
lines.en: The spikes on my tail sway with my breath

lines.zh: 我站在树荫下，一动不动
lines.en: I stand in the shade without moving
A small insect lands on my back

lines.zh: 我注意到你，警惕的眼神扫过你
lines.en: I notice you, my wary gaze sweeps over you
I turn to you, increasing my alertness
I turn to you, maintaining my vigilance

lines.zh: 我看着你，确认你没有威胁
lines.en: I look at you, confirming you pose no threat

lines.zh: 我观察你，确定你是否值得信赖
lines.en: I observe you, determining if you are trustworthy

lines.zh: 我转向你，准备做出反应
lines.en: I turn to you, ready to react

lines.zh: 我注视着你，准备随时行动
lines.en: I gaze at you, ready to act at any moment

lines.zh: 我看着你，确保你的意图
lines.en: I look at you, ensuring your intentions

lines.zh: 我抬起头，打量你一会儿
lines.en: I lift my head and size you up
I swing my tail around to my flank
Shell damage, I need to rest.

lines.zh: 别惹我，否则有你好看的!
lines.en: Don't provoke me, or you'll regret it!

lines.zh: 滚开，不然就吃下我的刺!
lines.en: Get away or face my spikes!
Don't mess with me, I'm hungry!

lines.zh: 我保护自己不需要你们!
lines.en: I don't need you to protect me!

lines.zh: 吼！甲壳下藏着我的秘密！
lines.en: Rumble! Secrets lie beneath the armor!
This field is mine, go away!

lines.zh: 小心我的骨刺，它们很痛！
lines.en: Watch out for my spikes, they sting!
I am the guardian of the plains!
You won't get near my eggs!

lines.zh: 这些骨头都是我的骄傲！
猎物来了，准备好战斗吧！
lines.en: Prey is here, prepare to fight!

lines.zh: 你逃不掉的，我的爪子在等你！
lines.en: You can't escape, my claws await you!
My tail will knock you down!

lines.zh: 你跑得再快也逃不过我的注意！
小心，我的反击不会手下留情！
你的行动暴露了你的位置！
lines.en: Your movements have revealed your position!

lines.zh: 我要吃掉你，你这个小东西！
lines.en: I'm going to eat you, little thing!

lines.zh: 我会保护我的家园，不让你轻易得逞！
lines.en: I'll protect my home, you won't easily succeed!

lines.zh: 你踩到了我的那片草地
lines.en: You stepped on my patch of grass

lines.zh: 我慢慢转过笨重的身体
lines.en: I turn my heavy body slowly around

lines.zh: 锁定目标，准备发射骨刺！
lines.en: Target locked, prepare to shoot spikes!

lines.zh: 我要用我的武器保护自己！
lines.en: I'll use my weapon to protect myself!

lines.zh: 看着我的尾巴，它会说话！
lines.en: Watch my tail, it speaks volumes!

lines.zh: 我的盾牌可以挡任何攻击！
瞄准，射击，这是我的战斗方式！
lines.en: Target, shoot, this is my fighting style!

lines.zh: 我用我的骨刺来保护自己！
lines.en: I use my spikes to protect myself!

lines.zh: 你跑不掉了，我的尾巴就在你后面！
lines.en: You can't escape, my tail is behind you!

lines.zh: 我的反击只会让你更痛！
lines.en: My retaliation will only make you hurt more!

lines.zh: 我的尾巴对准了你的方向
lines.en: My tail is aimed your way
I wait for you to take two more steps
I scrape the ground with a forefoot
My tail sweeps through and the air grows heavy
I wheel around and swing my tail
After the blow I step back half a pace
I wrench myself out of the stone layer
The plates break the soil first, then my body
I shake the rubble off my back
The grass is crushed deep where I landed
I stand in the sunlight again
The ground sinks an inch under my feet

lines.zh: 我慢慢舒展僵硬的四肢
lines.en: I slowly stretch my stiff limbs
This meadow has its master again
Hit by projectile, wait to heal.
